content: FastAPI production checklist: pydantic-settings for config validation (fail fast on missing/misconfigured env vars); separate liveness vs readiness health endpoints (readiness checks dependencies, returns 503 if unavailable); rate limiting (e.g. Redis-backed, or slowapi) layered with auth + request validation; structured JSON logging with correlation/request IDs for traceability across auth/rate-limit/business-logic steps.
